data.name: THE BOX VR
data.detailed_description:
The Box is a new arcade game of Virtual Reality that will test your reflexes, your coolness and your ability to strategy. An action game that challenges you to keep playing again and again.
6 walls. 100 options per wall. Beware, enemies can come everywhere. No flank is safe, strategy and speed are key to overcome The Box. Compete with your friends in local mode or fight to be the best in the world.
The Box is a game inspired by traditional arcade games. The objective is to destroy all the enemies with the help of your pistols and your shields. By combining these 2 elements wisely you will be able to face hundreds of balls that want to kill you. Do not trust them, they explode, they shoot, they throw themselves at you, etc. Survive with the help of extras that will surprise you.

reviews.review:
Note: the sword glitch mentioned in this review has been fixed.

Honestly, I got the jist of it in about 20 minutes, but what's here isn't particularly engaging compared to competition in the genre of "arena" or "wave shooters".

[i]THE BOX VR[/i] pits the player against a bunch of bouncing balls in a square room while the player tries to dodge and pop them with laser pistols. Different colored balls have different properties, such as tracking the player on deployment, but every single ball type will split into two smaller balls that also need to be dispatched. If a ball hits you, the wave you're on restarts. Three hits and you're out.

The player's got pistols, shields (that are angled strangely) and I guess a sword, but I could never get the sword to activate using the grip button. All balls pop with one shot. Ther are powerups, like an explosive gun that I feel is actually slightly worse then than the starting pistol, double points and a very, very short range explosive that you can shoot.

Now, the premise seems fine, but after a few minutes of balls bouncing around off everything, including each other, it's very apparent that this game is in dire need of variation. Because the only danger is a ball hitting you, most of the time you're forced to either shoot everything as quickly as possible, or focus entirely on dodging, at eventually you'll hit a wall where you can't manage anymore. That's fine, in practice, but there's only so many waves before that happens constantly. Maybe it would be easier with the sword they keep asking me to use (as I said, it was unusable when I played), but I've played other wave shooters that feel less frustrating, more fun, but still ask of the same level of skill from the player.

I don't really think [i]THE BOX VR[/i] is bad, it's just not as good as some of the other similar titles out there that cost a similar amount. With some work it could become a viable option, but I don't see myself playing this over [i]Space Pirate Trainer[/i] or [i]Blasters of the Universe[/i] any time soon.
